dedupe_keys.name: computational simulation of ductile fracture in structural steel systems

description: Computational Simulation of Ductile Fracture in Structural Steel Systems is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Ioannis Koutromanos, Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (vt.edu). This project enhanced our understanding of the process by which steel structures incur fracture when subjected to strong earthquake effects. The fracture in this case is termed "ductile", because it is driven by the development of inelastic (plastic) deformations. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: structural steel; cyclic loading;ductile fracture;ultra low-cycle fatigue. Published 2021-07-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
